## Key-only page

This page has NO exercises — only the key-page mount div. The filter must
still deploy both assets (exercise-feedback.js + key-page.js), inject the
auto-bootstrap, and call mountKeyPage (C14 — guards broadened to
`has_blendtutor or has_key`).
